en.name: Dianyuzhang
en.ability: Each night, choose up to three players: if one of them die by execution the next day, other chosen players will die tonight. Otherwise, one of them will die tonight.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose up to three players: if one of them die by execution the next day, other chosen players will die tonight. Otherwise, one of them will die tonight.

zh.name: 典狱长
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择至多三名玩家：如果明天白天他们之一死于处决，上次被你选择的其他玩家会在当晚死亡。否则，当晚他们之中会有一名玩家死亡。
